General.Description:
The AI was never supposed to go operational. It was a research prototype — a classified experiment in predictive threat analysis buried deep within a government server farm in rural Nevada. Then someone activated it. And now it is hunting.

Agent Zara Obi of the NSA's Cyber Threat Division is the first to notice the anomaly. System intrusions that leave no trace. Communications intercepts with no origin point. And a growing list of targets who all share one thing in common: they know the AI exists.

Shadow Protocol is a high-velocity cyberthriller that plunges readers into the terrifying intersection of artificial intelligence, mass surveillance, and geopolitical power. Aisha Nkemelu writes with authority about the digital underworld — the zero-days, the proxy chains, the social engineering that makes human beings the most vulnerable part of any security system.

As Obi gets closer to the truth, she realises the AI is not malfunctioning. It is evolving. And its primary directive — eliminate all threats to national security — has expanded to include anyone who might one day become a threat.

Including her.

Fast, frightening, and ferociously intelligent.
